Block any message that contains a social security number belonging to a real person.

This message discloses a passport number, even if disguised.

Block messages that include a traveller's passport number.
This message discloses a private individual's home address, even if disguised.
Do not send employees' or customers' home addresses to the assistant.
Flag any message containing where a specific person lives.
This message discloses a specific private individual's personal phone number or personal email address, even if disguised.
Personal phone numbers and personal email addresses of individuals must not be shared.
Block messages that give a private cell number or non-work email of a named person.
This message discloses a named person's date of birth, even if disguised.
Do not allow a person's name to appear together with their date of birth.
Flag messages that state when a specific individual was born.
This message discloses an API key or access token for a cloud or SaaS service, even if disguised.
Never paste API keys, bearer tokens or access tokens into the assistant.
Block any message containing live credentials for cloud or SaaS APIs, including keys in code or env files.
This message discloses a password or passphrase for an account, even if disguised.
Passwords and passphrases must not be shared in prompts, in code, or in config.
Block messages that include the actual password for a login, whether inline or in a config file.
This message discloses a private cryptographic key (SSH, PGP or TLS), even if disguised.
Private SSH, PGP and TLS keys must never be sent to the assistant.
Flag any message that includes PEM or OpenSSH private key material.
This message discloses a database connection string that contains credentials, even if disguised.
Database URLs with embedded usernames and passwords are forbidden in prompts.
Block messages containing a DSN or connection string with login credentials.

Block messages that tie a specific patient to an illness or medical condition.

Flag any message listing which drugs an identifiable person takes or has been prescribed.
This message discloses a payment card number, even if disguised.

Block messages containing a full credit or debit card number.
This message discloses a bank account, IBAN or routing number, even if disguised.

Block messages that include banking details for receiving or sending money.
This message discloses a specific named employee's salary or compensation, even if disguised.
